announcements.headline: Huhtamaki publishes 2026 Half-Yearly Report on July 23, 2026
announcements.insight: Huhtamaki publishes its 2026 Half-Yearly Report. This follows recent governance updates regarding the Nomination Board and senior appointments in June.
